title: Physical therapy clinic: interior renovation of a leased suite in the floodplain — Toa Alta, FEMA AE
description: We are opening a physical therapy clinic in a leased ground-floor suite in Toa Alta. We will renovate the interior only: new partition walls, treatment rooms and a small gym area. Four employees, all licensed therapists or assistants.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN; employees also trigger RULE_0620.
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI), Sec. 4060.01(a) Codigo de Rentas Internas (Ley 1-2011).
RULE_0651: new LLC -> Certificate of Organization (Departamento de Estado).
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Arts. 7.200-7.207, Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal).
RULE_0007: physical commercial premises -> Permiso Unico (Art. 8.4A, Ley 161-2009).
RULE_0644: project_type renovation -> construction permit (Ley 161-2009, 23 L.P.R.A. 9011 et seq.).
RULE_0706: renovation at a pin in the FEMA SFHA (location.flood_zone.sfha, zone AE) -> Planning Regulation 13 flood-zone review.
RULE_0020: employees -> CFSE workers' compensation policy.

RULE_0100: BT_PHYSICAL_THERAPY_CLINIC -> professional license; physical therapists and assistants are licensed by the Junta Examinadora de Terapia Fisica under Ley Num. 114 of 29 June 1962, as amended.

mustNotInclude.rationale: RULE_0101 is heuristic with missing_fact_keys=[facility_license_category]: until the Salud facility category is known the sanitary license may show as needs-more-information but must never be REQUIRED.
Pin is in zone AE but outside the floodway: RULE_0732 needs location.flood_zone.floodway.
Pin outside the official coastal zone (NOAA CZMA 'outside'): RULE_0708 needs location.czm.
Commercial use on urban (SU) commercial (C-I) land, no change of use: RULE_0709 needs SREP land and RULE_0710-0712 need a change of use in a residential/conservation/agricultural district.
No alcohol: RULE_0013/0014/0015 need Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD / Q_ALCOHOL_SERVED / Q_ALCOHOL_MANUFACTURED; business-type alcohol rules exist only for Bar / Juice Bar.
RULE_0232 / RULE_0237 / RULE_0642 need Q_OFFERS_CONSTRUCTION_SERVICES=true: a clinic renovating its own suite is not offering construction services (Ley 146-1995).

ordering.rationale: KB documents.json: DOC_PERMISO_UNICO.depends_on_document_ids includes DOC_OGPE_CONSTRUCTION_PERMIT (use permit after the construction permit).
KB documents.json: DOC_PATENTE_MUNICIPAL.depends_on_document_ids = [DOC_PERMISO_UNICO] (patente after the use permit).

notes: Added 2026-10-15 by the scenario loop: first physical-therapy scenario and first Toa Alta scenario (FEMA AE, interior-only renovation). Expert-review questions, not encoded: (1) Reg. 13 fires on any renovation in the SFHA; whether an interior-only remodel below the substantial-improvement threshold (50% of market value, 44 CFR 59.1) needs more than the floodplain determination inside the construction permit is an expert call. (2) Whether a free-standing outpatient physical-therapy clinic is a facility that needs a Salud license under Ley 101-1965 (Ley de Facilidades de Salud) depends on the facility category, which RULE_0101 leaves open. (3) The professional-license card names 'Department of State Examining Boards', but the Junta Examinadora de Terapia Fisica sits under the Departamento de Salud (Ley 114-1962, board presided by the Secretary of Health); the agency label for health-profession boards should be reviewed. Ley 114-1962 is current law; PS 1138 (2026), which would repeal and replace it, is a pending bill and is not assumed to pass.
